pins.name: 5V
pins.notes: Pin 3. Needs 5 V for the fan: use VIN

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: Pin 6. UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: Pin 7. UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (9600 baud, 3.3 V level)
